    # Get transactions for this month
    month_transactions = monthly_stats['transactions']
    
    # For each card scheme, calculate fees for this month
    for card_scheme in results.keys():
        scheme_month_data = month_transactions[month_transactions['card_scheme'] == card_scheme]

                mcc=7372,

                monthly_fraud_level=monthly_stats['monthly_fraud_level_bucket'],

            )
            
            month_fees = sum(fees_dict.values())
            results[card_scheme]['total_fees'] += month_fees
            results[card_scheme]['transactions'] += len(scheme_month_data)
